method: Read from official vendor pages snapshotted in evals/benchmark/vendor-docs (see index.json for URLs and retrieval times). Prices in USD per million tokens, standard (synchronous) tier, global endpoint.

claude-haiku-5-5.notes: Prompt > 100,000 tokens: 0.50 / 2.50 (whole request). Thinking can be disabled at effort <= high.

claude-sonnet-5-5.notes: Thinking cannot be disabled; lowest mode is between_tools (no up-front thinking) at effort <= high.

claude-opus-5-5.notes: Thinking always on; effort is the only control.

gpt-6-luna.notes: reasoning.effort: none, low, medium, high, xhigh, max.

gpt-6.1-terra.notes: Not in the matrix (between Luna and Sol); available if stage 1 shows a gap.

gpt-6.1-sol.notes: reasoning.effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max (no none).

mistral-small-2603.notes: Mistral Small 4; reasoning_effort none or high.

mistral-large-4.notes: Public Preview (6 Oct 2026); reasoning_effort low, medium, high.

ministral-14b-2512.notes: Ministral 3 14B; API id from the official model page (mistral--docs-mistral-ai-models-ministral-3-14b-25-12.txt).

discounts_and_uplifts.anthropic: Batch API -50% (stacks with caching; not ZDR-eligible). inference_geo 'us' x1.1; no EU option on the first-party API (EU only via Bedrock EU profiles or Google Cloud 'eu' multi-region, +10%).
discounts_and_uplifts.openai: Batch/Flex -50%. Data residency (eu.api.openai.com) +10%, subject to sales eligibility; ZDR / Modified Abuse Monitoring by prior approval; default abuse-monitoring retention up to 30 days.
discounts_and_uplifts.mistral: Batch -50%. EU regional endpoint api.eu.mistral.ai +10% (Batch and Files not available there). Default API data retention: not verified (legal pages not readable as text).

embeddings_for_pd24b.anthropic: No own embedding model (docs point to Voyage AI); a second vendor would be needed.
embeddings_for_pd24b.openai: text-embedding-3-small / -large documented; prices not read yet (PD-24b).
